verses.en: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.sm: UAao, ona taupulepule ai lea o a le au faitaulaga sili uma ma toeaina o le nuu ia Iesu ina ia fasioti ia te ia;

verses.en: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.sm: ua latou noanoa ia te ia, ona latou ta‘ita‘i ai lea ia te ia, ma tuu atu ai ia Ponotio Pilato le alii.

verses.en: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Iuta, o le na faalataina o ia, ua faasalaina o ia, ona salamo ai lea o ia, ua toe ave tupe e tolugafulu i le au faitaulaga sili ma toeaina,

verses.en: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Ua, ou agasala, ina ua ou faalata le ua le sala. A ua latou faapea mai, Sa matou mea ea lena ? faitalia lava oe.

verses.en: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.sm: Ona lafo ai lea e ia o tupe i le malumalu, ua alu ese; ona alu ai lea o ia ua noa o ia e ia.

verses.en: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.sm: Ona tago ai lea o le au faitaulaga sili i tupe, ua faapea ane, E sa ona tuu ia mea i le mea e teu ai oloa, auā o le tau o le toto.

verses.en: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
verses.sm: Ua latou filifili, ona faatau a‘i lea o le fanua o le fai ipu omea, e tatanu ai tagata ese.

w.en: his and cause to fought with?

verses.en: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua igoa ai lea fanua, O le fanua o le toto, ua oo lava i nei ona po.

verses.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
verses.sm: Ona taunuu ai lea o le upu a le perofeta o Ieremia, ua faapea mai, Ua latou tago i tupe e tolugafulu, o le tau lea o le na faatatauina, na faatatauina e nisi o le fanauga a Isaraelu ;

verses.en: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.sm: ona latou faatau a‘i lea o ie fanua o le fai ipu omea, e pei ona fetalai mai ai ia te au o le Alii.

w.en: his and they cause to fought with?

verses.en: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.sm: Ua tu Iesu i luma o le alii; ona fesili mai ai lea o le alii ia te ia,

verses.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.sm: ua faapea mai, O oe ea o le tupu o tagata Iutaia ? Ona fetalai atu ai lea moli ia te ia e le au faitaulaga sili ma toeaina, a ua leai sana tali.

verses.en: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Pilato ia te ia, Ua e le faalogo ea i le tele o mea ua latou molimau mai ai ia te oe ?

verses.en: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.sm: A ua le tali atu ia ia te ia i se upu e tasi; ona matuā ofo ai lea o le alii.

verses.en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.sm: Ua masani le alii e tatala atu i lea tausamiga ma lea tausamiga i le motu o tagata se tasi tagata ua noanoatia,

verses.en: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.sm: o le ua latou loto i ai. O ona po ia sa i ai ia te i latou lc tagata ua noanoatia ua logologoa, e igoa ia Parapa.

verses.en: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.sm: O lea na fai atu ai Pilato ia te i latou, ina ua potopoto i latou, Po o ai tou te loto i ai ou te tatalaina atu ia te outou ? o Parapa ea ? po o lesu le ua igoa ia Keriso?

verses.en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.sm: Auā ua na iloa o le mataua ua latou tuuina atu ai o ia.

verses.en: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.sm: Ua tietie o ia 1 le nofoa faamasino, ona sau ai lea o le feau mai lana avā, ua faapea mai, Ne‘i e mao i lea tagata amiotonu ; auā na ou matuā tigaina analeila i le miti ia te ia.

verses.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.sm: A ua faaoso e le au faitaulaga sili ma toeaina i le motu o tagata ia latou fai atu, o Parapa, a ia fasiotia Iesu.

verses.en: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o le alii,ua faapea atu ia te i latou, O ai so laua tou te loto i ai ou te tatalaina atu ia te outou ? Ona latou fai mai ai lea, O Parapa.

verses.en: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Pilato ia te i latou, Se a foi le mea ou te faia ia lesu o le ua igoa ia Keriso? Ona fai mai ai lea o i latou uma ia te ia, la faasatauroina ia.

verses.en: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.sm: A ua fai atu le alii, Pe se a foi se leaga ua ia faia? A ua atili ai ona alalaga i latou, ua faapea mai, Ia faasatauroina ia.

verses.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Pilato, ua le aoga lana upu, a e atili ai le vāvaō, ona tago ai lea o ia i le vai, ua fafano ai ona lima i luma o le motu o tagata, ua faapea atu, Ou te mamā a‘u i le toto o lenei tagata amiotonu; faitalia lava outou.

verses.en: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o le nuu uma, ua faapea mai, la i luga ia i matou, ma a matou fanau lona toto.

verses.en: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.sm: Ona tatalaina atu ai lea e ia o Parapa ia te i latou, a ua sasaina e ia o Iesu, ma tuuina atu o ia ia faasatauroina.

verses.en: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
verses.sm: Ua ta‘ita‘iina Iesu e le fau a le alii i le maota o le alii,

verses.en: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.sm: ona latou faapotopotoina ai lea ia te ia o le ona latou faaofuina ai lea o ia i le ofu mūmū.

verses.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.sm: Ua latou taataai foi laau tuitui ua fai a‘i le pale, ona latou faaee ai lea i lona ao, ua tuu foi le u i lona aao taumatau; ona latou tootuli ai lea i ona luma, ua faatauemu mai ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Talofa, le tupu o tagata Iutaia!

verses.en: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.sm: Ua feanu i latou ia te ia, ona latou tago ai lea i le u, ma ta i lona ao.

verses.en: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona latou faatauemu mai ia te ia, ona latou tatala ese lea o le ofu, ma faaofu ia te ia i ona lava ofu; ona latou ta‘ita‘i atu ai lea ia te ia ia faasatauroina.

verses.en: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.sm: Ua latou o atu, ona iloa ai lea e i latou o le tagata Kurene, e igoa ia Simona, ua latou faatauanau ia te ia ia ave lona satauro.

verses.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.sm: Ua latou oo atu i le mea ua igoa ia Kolokota, o lona uiga, O le mea o i ai le ulupoo ;

verses.en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
verses.sm: ona latou avatu lea ia te ia le vineta ua fefiloi ma le laau oona, ia inu ai; ua tofotofo e ia, a ua le mafai ona inu ai.

verses.en: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.sm: Ua latou faasatauro ia te ia, ona tufatufa ai iea e i latou o ona ofu, ua latou fai ai le vili; ina ia taunuu ai le upu a le perofeta, Ua latou tufatufaina o‘u ofu mo i latou, ua latou faia foi le vili i lo‘u ofu tino.

verses.en: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.sm: Ua latou nonofo i lea mea ua leoleo ia te ia.

verses.en: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuu foi i luga ae o lona ao le tusi i le mea na molia ai o ia, O IESU LENEI, O LE TUPU O TAGATA IUTAIA.

verses.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.sm: Ona latou faasatauro lea faatasi ma ia tagata fao mea e toalua, o le tasi i le itu taumatau, ma le tasi i le itu tauagavale.

verses.en: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.sm: Ua upu leaga ia te ia o e na ui aue, ma lialiai o latou ulu,

verses.en: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.sm: ua faapea mai, O oe na, o le lepeti i le malumalu, ma toe faia i aso e tolu, ina faaola ia oe ia te oe. Afai o oe le Alo o le Atua, ina alu ifo ia i le satauro.

verses.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.sm: Ua faapea foi ona faatauemu o le au faitaulaga sili, ma le au tusiupu, ma toeaina, ua faapea ane,

verses.en: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.sm: Na ia faaolaina isi tagata, e le mafaia e ia ona faaola ia te ia. Afai o le Tupu o Isaraelu o ia, ina alu ifo nei lava o ia i le satauro, ona tatou talitonu ai lea ia te ia.

verses.en: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.sm: Na, faatuatua ia i le Atua, ina laveai mai nei o ia ia te ia, afai e finagalo o ia ia te ia; auā na ia fai mai, O a‘u o le Atalii o le Atua.

verses.en: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.sm: Ua tagata fao mea ua faasatauroina ma ia.

verses.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.sm: Ua fua mai i le itu aso e ono, ua pogisa uma ai le nuu, ua oo lava i le itu aso e iva.

verses.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.sm: Ua lata i le itu aso e iva, ona alaga ai lea o lesu ma le leo tele, ua faapea atu, Eli, Eli, lama sapatani? o lona uiga lenei, Lo‘u Atua e, lo‘u Atua e, se a le mea ua e tuulafoai mai ai a‘u?

verses.en: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai nisi o e na tutū mai, ona latou faapea atu ai lea, Ua valaau atu lenei tagata ia Elia.

verses.en: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.sm: Ona momo‘e loa ai lea o so latou, ua tago i le omomi, ua fufui ai i le vineta, ma tuu i luga i le pito laau, ua faainu ia te ia.

verses.en: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.sm: A ua faapea ane i latou uma, Tuu ai pea ia, se‘i tatou iloa pe sau Elia na te faaolaina o ia.

verses.en: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.sm: Ua toe alaga Iesu ma le leo tele, ona tuuina atu ai lea e ia o lona agaga.

verses.en: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua saeluaina le ie puipui o le malumalu, ua amata ifo i luga, ua oo i lalo; ua luluina foi le eleele, ua mavaevae foi papa ;

verses.en: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.sm: ua avanoa foi tuugamau, ua toe tutū mai foi tino o tagata paia e toatele na momoe,

verses.en: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.sm: na mavae foi lona toe tu mai, ona latou o mai ai lea nai tuugamau, ma latou o atu i le aai paia, ua iloa i latou e tagata e toatele.

verses.en: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.sm: O le ta‘ita‘i foi o le toaselau, ma e na leoleo ia Iesu faatasi ma ia, na latou iloa le mafuie ma mea na faia, ona latou matuā matatau ai lea, ua faapea ane, E moni, o le Alo lava lenei o le Atua.

verses.en: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.sm: Sa i ai foi fafine e toatele na vaavaai mamao mai, o i latou ia na mulimuli mai ia Iesu mai Kalilaia, ma auauna mai ia te ia;

verses.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
verses.sm: sa i ai ia te i latou o Maria le Makatala, ma Maria le tinā o Iakopo ma Lose, o le tinā foi o atalii o Sepetaio.

verses.en: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
verses.sm: Ua oo i le afiafi, ona sau ai lea o le tasi tagata mauoa, o le Arimataia, e igoa ia Iosefa, o ia foi o le soo o Iesu ;

verses.en: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.sm: ua alu atu o ia ia Pilato, ua faanoi atu ai i le tino o Iesu. Ona fai atu ai lea o Pilato ia tuu ane le tino.

verses.en: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.sm: Ua ave e Iosefa le tino, ona aui ai lea i le ie lino e mamā.

verses.en: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.sm: Ua tuu ai i lona tuugamau fou na foa i le papa ; ua fuli atu e ia le maa tele i le gutu o le tuugamau, ona alu ai leā o ia.

verses.en: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.sm: Sa i ai Maria le Makatala, ma le Isi Maria, sa la nonofo feagai ma le tuugamau.

verses.en: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.sm: O le taeao, o le aso lea e tuaoi ma le aso o le sauniga, ua faapotopoto atu ai ia Pilato le au faitaulaga sili ma le au faresaio,

verses.en: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Le alii e, ua matou manatua, na fai mai lena tagata pepelo, ina o ola mai o ia, A mavae aso e tolu ou te toe tu mai ai.

verses.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia e fetalai ane, ia faamauina le tuugamau seia oo i le aso tolu, ina ne‘i o atu ona soo i le po, ma gaoi ia te ia, ma latou fai atu i le nuu, Ua. toe tu mai ia nai e ua oti; ona sili ai lea o le pepelo e mulimuli i le na muamua.

verses.en: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane ai lea o Pilato ia te i latou, Ua ia te outou leoleo, ina o ia, faitalia lava ontou ona faamau ai.

verses.en: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.sm: Ona latou o ai lea, ua faamauina le tuu- , gamau, ua faamaufaailoga i le maa, ma tuu ai tagata e leoleo.
